intro: The Runed Scroll is a curious document tied with a silvery ribbon found in the wilds of Kalimdor. Its formal appearance suggests military or administrative communications originating from the night elves across the border. Discovering it leads Horde scouts directly to the Mor'shan Rampart to warn the guards of northern activity.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The official-looking scroll is wrapped tightly with a silvery ribbon. You're sure someone would be interested in seeing this, but who?
There is an outpost close to the Ashenvale border to the north, and if the information on this scroll involves the night elves, this would be the place to take it.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well now... Where did you find this?
